mathlib_searches.results: No existing theorem combines the affine tower unit comparison with the ordered coefficient descent.

title: Affine tower unit base change equals ordered coefficient descent
statement: For a morphism of schemes f:T→S on which N is invertible, the affine-tower right base-change isomorphism at the constant unit, followed by the pullback of the constant unit, equals the canonical ordered Tate coefficient descent comparison. This contains no vector bundle or frame.

proof.text: Prove the stronger equality with the target descent left on the left-hand side. At tower length zero use the canonical left and right identity laws for derived inverse image and naturality of its identity isomorphism. This works for an arbitrary input isomorphism; no constant-unit composition theorem is needed.

At a successor expand the recursive coefficient descent and right base-change map. Apply the single-coordinate descent square at the previous right-adjoint object and the previous base-change isomorphism. The induction hypothesis handles the old coefficient factor; the normalized shifted-line square handles the new line factor. Tensor naturality and monoidality combine these two equalities.

proof.text: Use naturality of the projection square and composition isomorphisms, then paste the one-coordinate square with the preceding tower square. Associativity of canonical inverse-image composition identifies this with the full successor square. Cancel the final descent isomorphism to obtain the exact original equality.

lean.statement:
theorem affineTraceRightBaseChange_unit_coefficient
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {T S : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    affineTraceRightBaseChange A N hA t f hS d (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S) ≪≫
      (affineTraceRight A N hA T d).mapIso (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f) =
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A (affineTraceMap f d)).mapIso
        (affineLinearCoefficientDescent A N hA t S hS d) ≪≫
      (derivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (affineTraceMap_isPullback f d).toCommSq).symm.app
          (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA S d) ≪≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (affineTraceProjection T d)).mapIso
        (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t f hS d) ≪≫
      (affineLinearCoefficientDescent A N hA t T hT d).symm
